definitions.explanation: A company that stages musical theater, either opera or revue. In Japan the word calls to mind first the {宝塚|たからづか}{歌劇団|かげきだん}, the all-female Takarazuka Revue.

examples.japanese: {宝塚|たからづか}{歌劇団|かげきだん}

examples.english: My daughter dreams of joining a revue company.

examples.japanese: {宝塚|たからづか}{歌劇団|かげきだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: In the Takarazuka Revue, women play the male roles too.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {宝塚|たからづか}{歌劇団|かげきだん}, founded in 1913, has an all-female cast: performers who play men are {男役|おとこやく} and those who play women {娘役|むすめやく}. Its stars train first at the {宝塚|たからづか}⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧. The OSK{日本|にっぽん}{歌劇団|かげきだん} in Osaka is a similar troupe.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧: theater company — for spoken drama
- ⟦オペラ→オペラ：28763_opera⟧: opera — the art form itself
